cuts.title: Banned from a mall for his fans, then Kenya showed up
cuts.hook: Houston banned Speed over his fans
cuts.retelling: IShowSpeed is banned from a Houston mall because his fans showed up, and four months later in Kenya thousands of those fans fill a plaza for him with no one stopping them.

cuts.title: Jynxzi's first gold knife, then the Karambit Doppler
cuts.hook: Jynxzi's first gold, then a Doppler
cuts.retelling: Jynxzi pulls his first gold knife from a case, hears it appraised at only $113, then opens another case weeks later and hits a Factory New Karambit Doppler.

cuts.title: Kai Cenat slapped Ray, then Ray hit 1 million
cuts.retelling: Kai Cenat slaps streamer Ray in a bathroom and apologizes over and over, and two days later Ray hits one million followers and shouts out Kai among everyone else.

cuts.hook: A woman with a suitcase turned up

cuts.title: Kai Cenat Mistakes A Stranger For ExtraEmily At The AMAs
cuts.hook: Kai mistakes a stranger for ExtraEmily
cuts.retelling: Kai praises Emily's cheerful Streamer University pitch, then sixteen days later at the AMAs he shouts 'Emily?' at a stranger, apologizes, and says 'That was Emily'.
